description: Curated reference catalog of 1:50 mining & construction diecast models. Facts compiled from manufacturer/retailer catalogs; used to ground Hoardr's AI identify + value features and to power add-item autocomplete. Facts only (not copyrightable); no vendor photos or descriptions copied.

models.notes: One of the most collected CAT mining trucks; sold in Core Classics and higher-detail High Line trims.
The flagship of the niche — CAT 797F is one of the largest haul trucks in the world.

models.modelName: Cat 797F Tier 4 Mining Truck - Copper Finish
models.notes: Premium limited special-finish edition; commands a large premium over the standard 85655. Exact run size not yet verified.
AC electric-drive haul truck.
AC electric-drive haul truck; sister to the 798 AC.

models.modelName: Cat MWT30 Mining Truck Water Tank (Mega)
models.notes: Water tank truck on the 793F chassis — mine-site support vehicle.
Large production wheel loader used in quarry/mine loading.
LHD (load-haul-dump) underground loader.

models.modelName: Cat R2900 XE Underground Mining Loader
models.notes: Diesel-electric LHD underground loader.
Articulated underground haul truck.
Articulated underground haul truck.
Komatsu's largest ultra-class haul truck.
Komatsu ultra class electric drive mining truck; the practical 1:50 stand in for the 930E, which has no current 1:50 diecast.
Mechanical-drive rigid dump truck.
Large hybrid-drive mining wheel loader.
Hybrid wheel loader.
Underground continuous mining machine.
Rotary blasthole drill rig.
Large electric rope shovel (P&H is a Komatsu brand). High-end centrepiece model.
Standalone dipper/bucket accessory for the 4800-class shovel.
One of the world's largest hydraulic mining excavators; a niche flagship.
Large hydraulic mining excavator.
Mining-spec hydraulic excavator.
Liebherr's largest hydrostatic crawler dozer. (Retailer listing filed it under excavators; it is a dozer.)
Ultra-class haul truck, long one of the highest-payload trucks in the world. A '400' numbered mine livery exists.
Volvo's rigid-frame mining hauler.
Underground articulated haul truck.
Large hydraulic mining excavator.

CORNERSTONE: one of the most iconic ultra class mining trucks. Researched 9 Sep 2026: no mainstream 1:50 diecast of the 930E is currently made. First Gear produce the sister 830E-AC (50-3273) and 980E-AT (50-3415) in 1:50; older Joal and Shinsei pieces turn up secondhand. Leave unverified until a specific 1:50 930E release is confirmed.
Current generation Liebherr ultra class hauler, successor to the T 282 B. Colour variants share the 2766 base number.

variants: Norscot 55216 (earlier release of the same casting)
models.notes: Widely collected mid class mining haul truck; originally a Norscot casting (55216), now issued by Diecast Masters.
Roughly 100 ton rigid off highway truck, a mine and quarry staple.

models.modelName: Cat 994K Wheel Loader (Rock Bucket, High Line)
models.notes: One of Caterpillar's largest wheel loaders, used to load ultra class haul trucks.
Large mining bulldozer used for ripping and dozing on benches.
The largest Caterpillar motor grader, used to build and maintain mine haul roads.

CORNERSTONE and the marquee dragline of the niche. A landmark 1:50 model, an NZG and TWH collaboration (NZG official product guide; branded and sold by TWH as a limited, high value piece). Researched 9 Sep 2026: exact article number not located. The ESCO/CR Mining dragline bucket was a separate TWH release (087a / 098-01334; a Weiss Brothers 40 Years bucket also exists).

CORNERSTONE: roughly 100 ton class rigid mining truck. Researched 9 Sep 2026: the only known 1:50 is a long discontinued Shinsei casting (secondhand only); Universal Hobbies current Komatsu 1:50 range is loaders, dozers and backhoes, not the HD785. A 1:45 Diapet HD785 exists and is recorded separately. Leave unverified until a current 1:50 SKU is confirmed.
Large hydraulic excavator; NZG produce several PC1250-11 configurations in 1:50.
Large hydraulic mining excavator; NZG 860 (backhoe variant 8601).

CORNERSTONE: one of Hitachi's largest mining excavators, commonly paired with the EH series trucks. Researched 9 Sep 2026: no 1:50 EX5600 found. TMC make the smaller EX1200-7 in 1:50 (2025); the EX5600 appears only in larger or premium formats. Leave unverified until a 1:50 EX5600 is confirmed.
CORNERSTONE: Hitachi ultra class AC drive haul truck. Researched 9 Sep 2026: no 1:50 diecast located (an EH5000AC-3 exists only in 1:87). Leave unverified until a 1:50 EH4000 is confirmed.
Compiled from a collector reference catalogue.
